response.sql: WITH mm AS (SELECT m.link_to_major AS major_id, mj.department AS department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member m JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id GROUP BY m.link_to_major, mj.department), tot AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total FROM mm), sh AS (SELECT mm.major_id, mm.department, mm.member_count, CAST(mm.member_count AS REAL) / tot.total AS share FROM mm, tot), da AS (SELECT sh.*, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS dept_avg FROM sh) SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, share - dept_avg AS diff_above_avg FROM da WHERE share > dept_avg ORDER BY diff_above_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
